attention-task-start--prepare-one-work-s.title: Ready one little space

learning-homework--tell-back-one-directi.title: Check the direction

learning-homework--tell-back-one-directi.description: Make sure the task makes sense.

learning-homework--tell-back-one-directi.title: Put it in your words
learning-homework--tell-back-one-directi.alt: Put it in your words, ages 11-13. Invite the child to show or restate the next learning instruction so the adult can clarify it.
learning-homework--tell-back-one-directi.description: Clear up the task before you work.

learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.title: Show where you need help
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.alt: Show where you need help, ages 3-5. Practice indicating the exact part of a learning activity that needs explanation or support.
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.description: A grown-up can help with your play.

learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.title: Ask one learning question
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.alt: Ask one learning question, ages 6-8. Practice indicating the exact part of a learning activity that needs explanation or support.
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.description: Tell someone which bit is tricky.

learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.title: Name the stuck spot
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.alt: Name the stuck spot, ages 9-10. Practice indicating the exact part of a learning activity that needs explanation or support.
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.description: Ask for the kind of help you need.

learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.title: Send a clear help request
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.alt: Send a clear help request, ages 11-13. Practice indicating the exact part of a learning activity that needs explanation or support.
learning-homework--ask-about-one-stuck-s.description: A short question can make support easier.

learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.title: Look at one example
learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.alt: Look at one example, ages 6-8. Look together at one part of an attempt and a suitable example to locate a useful next step.

learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.title: Compare one step
learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.alt: Compare one step, ages 9-10. Look together at one part of an attempt and a suitable example to locate a useful next step.
learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.description: Use an example to understand your work.

learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.title: Check one worked step
learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.alt: Check one worked step, ages 11-13. Look together at one part of an attempt and a suitable example to locate a useful next step.
learning-homework--compare-one-work-exam.description: Find a useful next move in an example.

learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.title: Show what you found
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.alt: Show what you found, ages 3-5. Invite a short explanation or demonstration of one idea from a recent learning experience.
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.description: Show a little discovery from your play.

learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.title: Teach one little thing
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.alt: Teach one little thing, ages 6-8. Invite a short explanation or demonstration of one idea from a recent learning experience.

learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.title: Explain one idea
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.alt: Explain one idea, ages 9-10. Invite a short explanation or demonstration of one idea from a recent learning experience.
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.description: Try putting one idea into your own words.

learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.title: Make one idea clear
learning-homework--explain-one-learned-t.alt: Make one idea clear, ages 11-13. Invite a short explanation or demonstration of one idea from a recent learning experience.

reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.title: Pick our story
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.alt: Pick our story, ages 3-5. Offer a child-selected story, poem, comic or other accessible text for a short shared reading encounter.
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.description: Choose a story to enjoy together.

reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.title: Choose a reading buddy text
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.alt: Choose a reading buddy text, ages 6-8. Offer a child-selected story, poem, comic or other accessible text for a short shared reading encounter.
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.description: You can read, listen or take turns.

reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.title: Share a text you like
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.alt: Share a text you like, ages 9-10. Offer a child-selected story, poem, comic or other accessible text for a short shared reading encounter.
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.description: Your interests can choose the reading.

reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.title: Bring one text to share
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.alt: Bring one text to share, ages 11-13. Offer a child-selected story, poem, comic or other accessible text for a short shared reading encounter.
reading-language--choose-and-share-a-tex.description: Pick something worth reading or hearing.

reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.title: Point to a picture
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.alt: Point to a picture, ages 3-5. Pause for the child to point out, question or comment on one part of a story or informational text.
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.description: Show a part that you notice.

reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.title: Find a story detail
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.alt: Find a story detail, ages 6-8. Pause for the child to point out, question or comment on one part of a story or informational text.
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.description: Tell us what caught your attention.

reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.title: Ask about one detail
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.alt: Ask about one detail, ages 9-10. Pause for the child to point out, question or comment on one part of a story or informational text.
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.description: A small detail can start a conversation.

reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.title: Bring one text question
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.alt: Bring one text question, ages 11-13. Pause for the child to point out, question or comment on one part of a story or informational text.
reading-language--point-to-one-story-det.description: Choose a detail worth talking about.

reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.title: Try a new word
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.alt: Try a new word, ages 3-5. Explore a word from everyday talk or a text through a meaning, example, picture or home-language connection.
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.description: Use a picture or action to explore a word.

reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.title: Find a word example
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.alt: Find a word example, ages 6-8. Explore a word from everyday talk or a text through a meaning, example, picture or home-language connection.

reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.title: Explore one useful word
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.alt: Explore one useful word, ages 9-10. Explore a word from everyday talk or a text through a meaning, example, picture or home-language connection.
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.description: Connect a word to something you know.

reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.title: Make one word usable
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.alt: Make one word usable, ages 11-13. Explore a word from everyday talk or a text through a meaning, example, picture or home-language connection.
reading-language--explore-one-new-word--.description: Choose a word you want to understand.

reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.title: Act a story part
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.alt: Act a story part, ages 3-5. Invite the child to retell or invent a short story moment using words, pictures, movement or objects.
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.description: Make one little story with a toy.

reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.title: Tell a little story
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.alt: Tell a little story, ages 6-8. Invite the child to retell or invent a short story moment using words, pictures, movement or objects.
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.description: A drawing or toy can help you tell it.

reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.title: Share one story moment
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.alt: Share one story moment, ages 9-10. Invite the child to retell or invent a short story moment using words, pictures, movement or objects.

reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.title: Retell it your way
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.alt: Retell it your way, ages 11-13. Invite the child to retell or invent a short story moment using words, pictures, movement or objects.
reading-language--tell-one-story-part--a.description: Choose how you want to tell a story.

practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.title: Pick a little try
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.alt: Pick a little try, ages 3-5. Let the child choose a manageable part of a meaningful skill to explore before deciding whether to continue.
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.description: Choose a small part of your play.

practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.title: Choose one skill part
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.alt: Choose one skill part, ages 6-8. Let the child choose a manageable part of a meaningful skill to explore before deciding whether to continue.
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.description: A little piece is enough to begin.

practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.title: Pick your practice piece
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.alt: Pick your practice piece, ages 9-10. Let the child choose a manageable part of a meaningful skill to explore before deciding whether to continue.
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.description: Work on one part you want to learn.

practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.title: Choose a practice focus
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.alt: Choose a practice focus, ages 11-13. Let the child choose a manageable part of a meaningful skill to explore before deciding whether to continue.
practice-persistence--choose-one-practic.description: Pick a useful part of your own goal.

practice-persistence--change-one-practic.title: Try another way
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.alt: Try another way, ages 3-5. When a voluntary skill attempt is not working, choose a different tool, method or level of support.
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.description: You can choose another way, watch or pause.

practice-persistence--change-one-practic.title: Change one small thing
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.alt: Change one small thing, ages 6-8. When a voluntary skill attempt is not working, choose a different tool, method or level of support.
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.description: You can use a new way to practice.

practice-persistence--change-one-practic.title: Test a different strategy
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.alt: Test a different strategy, ages 9-10. When a voluntary skill attempt is not working, choose a different tool, method or level of support.
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.description: Change the method when it is useful.

practice-persistence--change-one-practic.title: Run a practice experiment
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.alt: Run a practice experiment, ages 11-13. When a voluntary skill attempt is not working, choose a different tool, method or level of support.
practice-persistence--change-one-practic.description: A small change can teach you something.

practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.title: Try one helpful tip
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.alt: Try one helpful tip, ages 3-5. Offer one clear, respectful suggestion for a child-chosen skill, then let the child choose, question, try, defer or decline it.
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.description: A grown-up can show one small idea.

practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.title: Use one helpful tip
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.alt: Use one helpful tip, ages 6-8. Offer one clear, respectful suggestion for a child-chosen skill, then let the child choose, question, try, defer or decline it.

practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.title: Choose a feedback tip
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.alt: Choose a feedback tip, ages 9-10. Offer one clear, respectful suggestion for a child-chosen skill, then let the child choose, question, try, defer or decline it.
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.description: Use feedback that fits your goal.

practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.title: Test one feedback idea
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.alt: Test one feedback idea, ages 11-13. Offer one clear, respectful suggestion for a child-chosen skill, then let the child choose, question, try, defer or decline it.
practice-persistence--use-one-feedback-t.description: You can decide what advice to use.

practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.title: More, pause or change
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.alt: More, pause or change, ages 3-5. After a brief voluntary skill attempt, check support and energy before choosing to continue, pause or change the goal.
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.description: You can choose what happens next.

practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.title: Choose your next move
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.alt: Choose your next move, ages 6-8. After a brief voluntary skill attempt, check support and energy before choosing to continue, pause or change the goal.
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.description: A pause or a different plan is okay.

practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.title: Check your practice plan
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.alt: Check your practice plan, ages 9-10. After a brief voluntary skill attempt, check support and energy before choosing to continue, pause or change the goal.
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.description: Choose a next step that fits today.

practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.title: Decide what fits now
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.alt: Decide what fits now, ages 11-13. After a brief voluntary skill attempt, check support and energy before choosing to continue, pause or change the goal.
practice-persistence--choose-continue-pa.description: Your plan can change with your needs.

friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.title: Ask someone to play
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.alt: Ask someone to play, ages 3-5. Practice offering another child a concrete optional activity while making room for yes, no or another idea.
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.description: A friend can choose whether to join.

friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.title: Offer a play choice
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.alt: Offer a play choice, ages 6-8. Practice offering another child a concrete optional activity while making room for yes, no or another idea.
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.description: Invite someone to a game you like.

friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.title: Make a friendly invitation
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.alt: Make a friendly invitation, ages 9-10. Practice offering another child a concrete optional activity while making room for yes, no or another idea.
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.description: Offer an activity, with room for no.

friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.title: Invite without pressure
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.alt: Invite without pressure, ages 11-13. Practice offering another child a concrete optional activity while making room for yes, no or another idea.
friendship-social-play--invite-with-an-o.description: Offer a shared activity that fits you both.

friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.title: Pick our play rule
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.alt: Pick our play rule, ages 3-5. Before a shared game, invite participants to agree on one concrete rule that supports access and enjoyment.
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.description: Choose one way to play together.

friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.title: Choose one game rule
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.alt: Choose one game rule, ages 6-8. Before a shared game, invite participants to agree on one concrete rule that supports access and enjoyment.
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.description: Agree on one thing before you play.

friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.title: Agree before the game
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.alt: Agree before the game, ages 9-10. Before a shared game, invite participants to agree on one concrete rule that supports access and enjoyment.
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.description: Make the game clear and fair to join.

friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.title: Set a shared game agreement
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.alt: Set a shared game agreement, ages 11-13. Before a shared game, invite participants to agree on one concrete rule that supports access and enjoyment.
friendship-social-play--agree-one-play-r.description: Make space for everyone’s access and choice.

friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.title: Make a turn together
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.alt: Make a turn together, ages 3-5. Help players make one clear, flexible opportunity for each willing person to participate.
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.description: A grown-up can help each person join.

friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.title: Make room for a turn
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.alt: Make room for a turn, ages 6-8. Help players make one clear, flexible opportunity for each willing person to participate.
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.description: Choose a way everyone can have a go.

friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.title: Plan a fair turn
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.alt: Plan a fair turn, ages 9-10. Help players make one clear, flexible opportunity for each willing person to participate.
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.description: Help everyone who wants to join.

friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.title: Share the participation space
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.alt: Share the participation space, ages 11-13. Help players make one clear, flexible opportunity for each willing person to participate.
friendship-social-play--make-room-for-a-.description: A role or turn can make room for someone.

friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.title: More play or stop
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.alt: More play or stop, ages 3-5. Practice checking whether a peer wants the activity to continue, change or stop.
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.description: A friend can show what they want.

friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.title: Ask what they want
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.alt: Ask what they want, ages 6-8. Practice checking whether a peer wants the activity to continue, change or stop.
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.description: Check if a friend wants the same game.

friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.title: Check the play plan
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.alt: Check the play plan, ages 9-10. Practice checking whether a peer wants the activity to continue, change or stop.

friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.title: Check in with your friend
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.alt: Check in with your friend, ages 11-13. Practice checking whether a peer wants the activity to continue, change or stop.
friendship-social-play--check-a-friends-.description: An activity only works while people want it.

kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.title: Offer a little help
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.alt: Offer a little help, ages 3-5. Invite the child to offer one safe, feasible action after checking whether another person wants help.
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.description: Ask if someone wants a small hand.

kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.title: Ask before helping
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.alt: Ask before helping, ages 6-8. Invite the child to offer one safe, feasible action after checking whether another person wants help.
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.description: A small useful offer can be kind.

kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.title: Offer useful help
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.alt: Offer useful help, ages 9-10. Invite the child to offer one safe, feasible action after checking whether another person wants help.
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.description: Check what help someone actually wants.

kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.title: Offer help with boundaries
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.alt: Offer help with boundaries, ages 11-13. Invite the child to offer one safe, feasible action after checking whether another person wants help.
kindness-cooperation--offer-one-useful-h.description: You can contribute without taking over.

kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.title: Choose a little job
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.alt: Choose a little job, ages 3-5. Plan who will do one small part of a voluntary shared activity so the work is accessible and clear.

kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.title: Pick your team part
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.alt: Pick your team part, ages 6-8. Plan who will do one small part of a voluntary shared activity so the work is accessible and clear.
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.description: Choose one part of a shared activity.

kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.title: Agree on the jobs
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.alt: Agree on the jobs, ages 9-10. Plan who will do one small part of a voluntary shared activity so the work is accessible and clear.
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.description: Make a plan that fits the people.

kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.title: Share the work fairly
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.alt: Share the work fairly, ages 11-13. Plan who will do one small part of a voluntary shared activity so the work is accessible and clear.
kindness-cooperation--make-a-shared-task.description: Match the roles to people’s choices and access.

kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.title: Notice a little help
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.alt: Notice a little help, ages 3-5. Offer a sincere, optional acknowledgment of one thing another person did that was helpful or interesting.
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.description: You can show something someone did.

kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.title: Name something helpful
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.alt: Name something helpful, ages 6-8. Offer a sincere, optional acknowledgment of one thing another person did that was helpful or interesting.

kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.title: Make a specific acknowledgment
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.alt: Make a specific acknowledgment, ages 9-10. Offer a sincere, optional acknowledgment of one thing another person did that was helpful or interesting.
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.description: Say what you noticed, if it feels true.

kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.title: Notice someone’s contribution
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.alt: Notice someone’s contribution, ages 11-13. Offer a sincere, optional acknowledgment of one thing another person did that was helpful or interesting.
kindness-cooperation--notice-a-specific-.description: A sincere detail can show you paid attention.

kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.title: Give the borrowed toy back
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.alt: Give the borrowed toy back, ages 3-5. Practice remembering ownership and returning one borrowed item or asking for a new agreed return time.
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.description: A grown-up can help return it.

kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.title: Return what you borrowed
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.alt: Return what you borrowed, ages 6-8. Practice remembering ownership and returning one borrowed item or asking for a new agreed return time.
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.description: Help an item get back to its owner.

kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.title: Check the borrowing plan
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.alt: Check the borrowing plan, ages 9-10. Practice remembering ownership and returning one borrowed item or asking for a new agreed return time.
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.description: Return it or ask about a new plan.

kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.title: Close the borrowing loop
kindness-cooperation--return-a-borrowed-.alt: Close the borrowing loop, ages 11-13. Practice remembering ownership and returning one borrowed item or asking for a new agreed return time.

conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.title: Show what happened
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.alt: Show what happened, ages 3-5. With adult support, describe an observable event in a safe disagreement before considering what help is needed.

conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.title: Tell one thing that happened
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.alt: Tell one thing that happened, ages 6-8. With adult support, describe an observable event in a safe disagreement before considering what help is needed.
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.description: You can use words or pictures.

conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.title: Describe one event
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.alt: Describe one event, ages 9-10. With adult support, describe an observable event in a safe disagreement before considering what help is needed.
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.description: Start with what you saw or heard.

conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.title: Put the event into words
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.alt: Put the event into words, ages 11-13. With adult support, describe an observable event in a safe disagreement before considering what help is needed.
conflict-repair-boundaries--describe-wha.description: You can describe a problem without solving it alone.

conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.title: Show your stop sign
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.alt: Show your stop sign, ages 3-5. Practice a short accessible boundary signal in a safe rehearsal and have adults respond to it consistently.
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.description: A grown-up will help you get space.

conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.title: Say you need space
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.alt: Say you need space, ages 6-8. Practice a short accessible boundary signal in a safe rehearsal and have adults respond to it consistently.
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.description: Your words or signal can set a limit.

conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.title: Make one boundary clear
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.alt: Make one boundary clear, ages 9-10. Practice a short accessible boundary signal in a safe rehearsal and have adults respond to it consistently.
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.description: You can ask for a change or for space.

conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.title: State your limit
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.alt: State your limit, ages 11-13. Practice a short accessible boundary signal in a safe rehearsal and have adults respond to it consistently.
conflict-repair-boundaries--state-one-bo.description: A boundary does not need a long defense.

conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.title: Help fix one thing
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.alt: Help fix one thing, ages 3-5. With adult help, choose a practical repair for a specific action without demanding affection, forgiveness or a scripted apology.
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.description: A grown-up can help make a repair.

conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.title: Choose a repair
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.alt: Choose a repair, ages 6-8. With adult help, choose a practical repair for a specific action without demanding affection, forgiveness or a scripted apology.
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.description: You can help with what happened.

conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.title: Make a useful repair
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.alt: Make a useful repair, ages 9-10. With adult help, choose a practical repair for a specific action without demanding affection, forgiveness or a scripted apology.
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.description: A repair can be an action, not just words.

conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.title: Offer a repair that fits
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.alt: Offer a repair that fits, ages 11-13. With adult help, choose a practical repair for a specific action without demanding affection, forgiveness or a scripted apology.
conflict-repair-boundaries--choose-one-r.description: The other person can choose whether to accept.

conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.title: Pick a safe play plan
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.alt: Pick a safe play plan, ages 3-5. With adult help, compare two acceptable next steps for an ordinary disagreement while preserving everyone’s boundaries.
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.description: A grown-up can help make room.

conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.title: Try a fair next plan
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.alt: Try a fair next plan, ages 6-8. With adult help, compare two acceptable next steps for an ordinary disagreement while preserving everyone’s boundaries.
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.description: Choose a plan that people can use.

conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.title: Compare two options
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.alt: Compare two options, ages 9-10. With adult help, compare two acceptable next steps for an ordinary disagreement while preserving everyone’s boundaries.
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.description: Look for a plan that respects both people.

conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.title: Choose a workable next step
conflict-repair-boundaries--check-both-o.alt: Choose a workable next step, ages 11-13. With adult help, compare two acceptable next steps for an ordinary disagreement while preserving everyone’s boundaries.

family-connection--child-led-together-ti.title: You lead our play
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.alt: You lead our play, ages 3-5. The adult offers attentive shared time around an activity the child chooses, with no teaching or performance agenda.
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.description: Choose something for us to do together. You can also choose space or not now.

family-connection--child-led-together-ti.title: Choose our together-time
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.alt: Choose our together-time, ages 6-8. The adult offers attentive shared time around an activity the child chooses, with no teaching or performance agenda.
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.description: Your grown-up will follow your idea. You can also choose space or not now.

family-connection--child-led-together-ti.title: Plan a little time together
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.alt: Plan a little time together, ages 9-10. The adult offers attentive shared time around an activity the child chooses, with no teaching or performance agenda.
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.description: Choose company that feels good to you. You can also choose space or not now.

family-connection--child-led-together-ti.title: Choose how we hang out
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.alt: Choose how we hang out, ages 11-13. The adult offers attentive shared time around an activity the child chooses, with no teaching or performance agenda.
family-connection--child-led-together-ti.description: Connection can fit your interests and space. You can also choose space or not now.

family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.title: Show a day picture
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.alt: Show a day picture, ages 3-5. Invite a short child-chosen detail, question or picture from the day while the adult listens without interrogating.
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.description: Choose something to show, or pass.

family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.title: Share a little moment
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.alt: Share a little moment, ages 6-8. Invite a short child-chosen detail, question or picture from the day while the adult listens without interrogating.
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.description: One little thing is enough, and you can pass.

family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.title: Choose a day detail
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.alt: Choose a day detail, ages 9-10. Invite a short child-chosen detail, question or picture from the day while the adult listens without interrogating.
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.description: You decide which part to share.

family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.title: Share what you choose
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.alt: Share what you choose, ages 11-13. Invite a short child-chosen detail, question or picture from the day while the adult listens without interrogating.
family-connection--share-one-day-detail-.description: A check-in can be short and private.

family-connection--ask-a-family-question.title: Ask a little question
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.alt: Ask a little question, ages 3-5. Offer a reciprocal conversation in which the child may ask an everyday question and hear a bounded adult answer.
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.description: You can ask about a grown-up’s favorite thing. You can pass or choose another time.

family-connection--ask-a-family-question.title: Ask about their day
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.alt: Ask about their day, ages 6-8. Offer a reciprocal conversation in which the child may ask an everyday question and hear a bounded adult answer.
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.description: Try a question you are curious about. You can pass or choose another time.

family-connection--ask-a-family-question.title: Start a family conversation
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.alt: Start a family conversation, ages 9-10. Offer a reciprocal conversation in which the child may ask an everyday question and hear a bounded adult answer.
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.description: A real question can help you learn about someone. You can pass or choose another time.

family-connection--ask-a-family-question.title: Ask a question that interests you
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.alt: Ask a question that interests you, ages 11-13. Offer a reciprocal conversation in which the child may ask an everyday question and hear a bounded adult answer.
family-connection--ask-a-family-question.description: You can be curious without sharing everything. You can pass or choose another time.

family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.title: Pick our hello
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.alt: Pick our hello, ages 3-5. Agree on a brief family connection cue that can flex with schedules, access and everyone’s preference.
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.description: Choose a way to say hello together.

family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.title: Make our tiny ritual
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.alt: Make our tiny ritual, ages 6-8. Agree on a brief family connection cue that can flex with schedules, access and everyone’s preference.
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.description: Choose a hello or goodbye that fits.

family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.title: Choose our check-in signal
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.alt: Choose our check-in signal, ages 9-10. Agree on a brief family connection cue that can flex with schedules, access and everyone’s preference.
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.description: A little ritual can fit your day.

family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.title: Design a small connection cue
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.alt: Design a small connection cue, ages 11-13. Agree on a brief family connection cue that can flex with schedules, access and everyone’s preference.
family-connection--choose-a-connection-r.description: Make a ritual that respects your space.

body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.title: Pick your hello
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.alt: Pick your hello, ages 3-5. Teach adults to offer a real choice of greeting and honor the child’s preference, including no greeting.
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.description: You choose how to greet someone.

body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.title: Choose your greeting
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.alt: Choose your greeting, ages 6-8. Teach adults to offer a real choice of greeting and honor the child’s preference, including no greeting.
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.description: A wave or no greeting is okay.

body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.title: Greet in your own way
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.alt: Greet in your own way, ages 9-10. Teach adults to offer a real choice of greeting and honor the child’s preference, including no greeting.
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.description: You can change your mind about touch.

body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.title: Make your greeting choice
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.alt: Make your greeting choice, ages 11-13. Teach adults to offer a real choice of greeting and honor the child’s preference, including no greeting.
body-autonomy-safety--choose-your-greeti.description: You decide whether a greeting includes touch.

body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.title: Ask before a high-five
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.alt: Ask before a high-five, ages 3-5. Practice adults and children asking before optional physical contact and stopping when someone does not want it.
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.description: The other person can choose yes or no.

body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.title: Ask, then wait
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.alt: Ask, then wait, ages 6-8. Practice adults and children asking before optional physical contact and stopping when someone does not want it.
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.description: Touch is only for people who want it.

body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.title: Check before contact
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.alt: Check before contact, ages 9-10. Practice adults and children asking before optional physical contact and stopping when someone does not want it.
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.description: People can choose and change their minds.

body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.title: Make optional touch a choice
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.alt: Make optional touch a choice, ages 11-13. Practice adults and children asking before optional physical contact and stopping when someone does not want it.
body-autonomy-safety--ask-before-touch--.description: A clear choice matters every time.

body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.title: Find a helping grown-up
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.alt: Find a helping grown-up, ages 3-5. Adults help the child locate and practice an accessible way to contact trusted support in different settings.
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.description: A grown-up can help you reach someone safe.

body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.title: Know where to get help
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.alt: Know where to get help, ages 6-8. Adults help the child locate and practice an accessible way to contact trusted support in different settings.
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.description: There is more than one grown-up who can listen.

body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.title: Check your help routes
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.alt: Check your help routes, ages 9-10. Adults help the child locate and practice an accessible way to contact trusted support in different settings.
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.description: You can try another safe adult if needed.

body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.title: Make help reachable
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.alt: Make help reachable, ages 11-13. Adults help the child locate and practice an accessible way to contact trusted support in different settings.
body-autonomy-safety--find-a-safe-adult-.description: Support should not depend on one person or app.

body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.title: You can tell a safe adult
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.alt: You can tell a safe adult, ages 3-5. Adults teach that a request involving private body parts, images, secrecy or threats can be brought to safe support without punishment or proof.
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.description: You are never in trouble for asking for help.

body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.title: Worries can be shared
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.alt: Worries can be shared, ages 6-8. Adults teach that a request involving private body parts, images, secrecy or threats can be brought to safe support without punishment or proof.
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.description: A secret or request can be told to a safe adult.

body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.title: Tell about worrying requests
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.alt: Tell about worrying requests, ages 9-10. Adults teach that a request involving private body parts, images, secrecy or threats can be brought to safe support without punishment or proof.
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.description: You can get help even if you are unsure.

body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.title: Get help with a worrying request
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.alt: Get help with a worrying request, ages 11-13. Adults teach that a request involving private body parts, images, secrecy or threats can be brought to safe support without punishment or proof.
body-autonomy-safety--tell-about-worryin.description: You are not to blame, even if you answered or told later.
